itens.texto:
Copom pausa cortes e bolsa ainda surfa ‘onda azul’ nos EUA; Ibovespa em dólar sobe nesta quinta-feira (5)
O mercado local digere a decisão do Copom da última quarta-feira (4) nesta quinta-feira (5). O Comitê de Política Monetária do Banco Central decidiu por manter a taxa Selic em 13,75% ao ano, em linha com o esperado pelo mercado.
Com a agenda relativamente mais esvaziada hoje, com destaque para a produção industrial de setembro — que deve recuar 0,3% na mediana das projeções do Broadcast —, os investidores continuam a digerir a “onda azul” nos Estados Unidos.
As eleições de meio de mandato (midterms) por lá apontaram uma ampla vitória democrata sobre os Republicanos e, mais especificamente, sobre o atual presidente Donald Trump.
A reação do mercado foi um verdadeiro rali em Wall Street e uma queda nos preços do petróleo, além da queda do dólar frente a uma cesta de moedas fortes.
Mercado brasileiro
Ibovespa: O Ibovespa (IBOV) acompanhou a melhora de apetite a risco em Wall Street e interrompeu a sequência de seis quedas nesta quarta-feira (4), em meio à expectativa para a decisão do Comitê de Política Monetária (Copom) do Banco Central (BC) sobre os juros.
O principal índice da bolsa brasileira terminou as negociações com alta de 1,23%, aos 167.563,47 pontos.
O dólar à vista encerrou o dia a R$ 5,4518, com queda de 0,65%.
O iShares MSCI Brazil (EWZ) — principal ETF brasileiro negociado em Nova York — sobe 0,71%, cotado a US$ 32,48.
Mercados internacionais
As bolsas asiáticas fecharam o pregão majoritariamente em alta, com exceção do Japão. Na Europa, os principais índices começaram o dia em alta. Os futuros de Nova York apontam para uma abertura sem um único sinal.

itens.titulo: 3M stock soars following $7.35 billion 'forever chemicals' settlement
itens.descricao: 3M stock soars following $7.35 billion 'forever chemicals' settlement Yahoo Finance
trechos: Payouts would cover personal injury claims related to firefighting foam made by 3M and be distributed over nine years to as many as 120,000 people, the St.
The litigation centers on PFAS, short for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, in products manufactured by 3M.
"Forever chemicals" do not break down easily in the human body or environment, and have been linked to health issues including higher cholesterol, low birth weight and kidney and testicular cancer.
The company did not admit liability, and plans a $5.8 billion pre-tax fourth-quarter charge that represents the present value of future payments.
UBS analyst Amit Mehrotra wrote that investors had expected an approximately $10 billion settlement, and the accord removes a "meaningful overhang" on 3M's shares.
At its peak, 3M stock rose 10% on Wednesday to its highest since March 2018, when it traded above $200.
In afternoon trading, the shares were up 9.8% at $194.37.
The settlement addresses about 99% of personal injury claims inside and outside the "aqueous film-forming foam" multi-district litigation in the federal court in Charleston, South Carolina.

itens.titulo: 3M settlement removes major PFAS overhang, UBS says
itens.descricao: 3M settlement removes major PFAS overhang, UBS says Yahoo Finance
trechos: 3M Co (NYSE:MMM) settlement covering about 99% of current PFAS personal injury claims removes a major overhang, UBS said, with the cost below its estimate of investor expectations.
UBS put the present-value cost of 3M's settlement at $5.8 billion, compared with its estimate that investors expected around $10 billion.
Total payments will reach $7.35 billion over nine years, with the settlement schedule placing disproportionately large payments in the final two years.
Payments begin with $50 million in 2026, followed by no payments in 2027, providing further detail on the timing of the company's financial obligations.
Alongside the settlement announcement, the board approved a new $6 billion share repurchase authorization, bringing the total authorization to $7.5 billion.
With greater clarity on those liabilities, UBS said 3M could attract a broader investor base, while maintaining its positive view of the company's growth and earnings opportunity.

itens.titulo: Micron and Sandisk valuation multiples are unbelievable as chip stocks get crushed
itens.descricao: Micron and Sandisk valuation multiples are unbelievable as chip stocks get crushed Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Just start with the two names that were (keyword: were) the leaders of the AI-fueled momentum for much of 2026: Sandisk (SNDK) and Micron (MU).
Micron stock crashed 14% on Thursday, bringing its one-month plunge to a startling 36%.
The rout has brought Micron's forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio down an almost laughable 4.8 times, according to Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace data.
The Street still expects Micron to grow earnings by at least 17% in its next fiscal year.
Sandisk is in the same valuation boat as Micron, trading at about 4.9 times estimated forward earnings on a P/E basis.
Sandisk stock is down 19% today, bringing its one-month drop to 29%.
For perspective here, the S&P 500 (^GSPC) trades at about 18.5 times estimated forward earnings.

itens.titulo: Keel Infrastructure Sells Entire $192M Bitcoin Treasury, Plans Daily BTC Sales
itens.descricao: Keel Infrastructure Sells Entire $192M Bitcoin Treasury, Plans Daily BTC Sales Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin miner turned AI infrastructure developer Keel Infrastructure (NASDAQ: $KEEL), formerly Bitfarms, sold its entire Bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC) treasury in the third quarter, offloading 2,520 coins for $192 million, the company reported Thursday.
The company holds about $780 million in cash and says lease negotiations are advanced at its three near-term sites, but it has not yet signed one.
According to the press release, the sales covered the 2,261 Bitcoin Keel held going into the quarter plus the 259 it mined, and the company timed them during periods of strength.
That works out to an average of roughly $76,200 per coin.

The loss from continuing operations widened to $62 million from $11 million, driven mainly by a $55 million non-cash unrealized loss on the fair value of capped calls tied to its 2025 convertible notes.

Adjusted EBITDA swung to a $27 million loss from a $19 million profit, and general and administrative expenses doubled to $34 million as the company hired senior specialists and booked higher stock-based compensation.
Keel had about $780 million in unrestricted cash as of Nov.
4 and no current need for debt or equity financing before signing a lease, according to Chief Financial Officer Jonathan Mir.

itens.titulo: Selic parada: por que Alberto Ramos, do Goldman Sachs, só vê novos cortes de juros em 2028
itens.descricao: Selic parada: por que Alberto Ramos, do Goldman Sachs, só vê novos cortes de juros em 2028 Seu Dinheiro
trechos: Selic parada: por que Alberto Ramos, do Goldman Sachs, só vê novos cortes de juros em 2028 Enquanto o Goldman Sachs vê a taxa básica de juros parada, o UBS ainda aposta em cortes no ano que vem.
A projeção do banco norte-americano é que a Selic permaneça nos atuais 13,75% ao ano até pelo menos o segundo trimestre de 2028.
Mesmo assim, os próximos cortes não deverão ser intensos, na casa de 0,75 ou 1 ponto percentual (p.p.).
Em relatório sobre a decisão do Copom, Ramos afirma que "vê espaço limitado para ajustes" mesmo em 2028.
Leia Também No comunicado de ontem, o Copom falou em uma "moderação mais acentuada" da economia e destacou que o mercado de trabalho continua resiliente, mas já apresenta sinais de arrefecimento.
A expectativa para o IPCA no fim de 2027, destacada no comunicado, saltou de 3,9% para 4,7%.
Para 2028, a projeção também subiu.
Para o economista, embora a preocupação com a inflação seja certa, o Copom não deu importância/ relevância suficiente ao forte aumento das expectativas de inflação de médio prazo para 2028-29.

itens.titulo: AMD CEO Lisa Su sees AI becoming 'essential to every aspect of our lives'
itens.descricao: AMD CEO Lisa Su sees AI becoming 'essential to every aspect of our lives' Yahoo Finance
trechos: "I think the market can sometimes be a little bit short-sighted.
It is what it is," AMD CEO Lisa Su said on Sozzi Unleashed.
"What I look at is in the long term, if you believe, which I do, I believe very deeply that computing, in many ways, equates to intelligence," Su added.
"So the more compute you have, the more intelligent your company is, the more problems you're going to be able to solve, the more you're going to accelerate your business.
Third quarter sales jumped 45% year over year to a record $13.38 billion, comfortably surpassing Wall Street consensus estimates of roughly $13.06 billion.
Adjusted earnings climbed 74% to $2.09 per share, easily topping analyst projections of $1.94 per share.

The blowout performance was anchored by AMD's Data Center segment, where revenue surged 97% to a record $8.5 billion on robust demand for EPYC server processors and the production ramp of Instinct MI450 AI accelerators.
For the fourth quarter, AMD said it sees 50% sequential growth in data centers.
resumo: "I think the market can sometimes be a little bit short-sighted.
It is what it is," AMD CEO Lisa Su said on Sozzi Unleashed.
"What I look at is in the long term, if you believe, which I do, I believe very deeply that computing, in many ways, equates to intelligence," Su added.
"So the more compute you have, the more intelligent your company is, the more problems you're going to be able to solve, the more you're going to accelerate your business.
Third quarter sales jumped 45% year over year to a record $13.38 billion, comfortably surpassing Wall Street consensus estimates of roughly $13.06 billion.
Adjusted earnings climbed 74% to $2.09 per share, easily topping analyst projections of $1.94 per share.

The blowout performance was anchored by AMD's Data Center segment, where revenue surged 97% to a record $8.5 billion on robust demand for EPYC server processors and the production ramp of Instinct MI450 AI accelerators.
For the fourth quarter, AMD said it sees 50% sequential growth in data centers.
